test_title: PYST 46: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

Some metals are iron.

Some iron are steel.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some metals are steel.

(II) All steel are iron.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e9e41e37b6375155d6dd4fbc106edfe942605c5303d33adbe1761f9a5685970.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some metals are steel → False( As, there is no direct relation between metals and steel. so, it can be a possibility but not define)

(II) All steel are iron → False(As, Some iron are steel. so, All steel are iron can be a possibility but not definite)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
